instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype for a data-dense logistics dashboard.
Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Install these via Google Fonts if necessary.
The UI should feel like an operational control room: avoid excessive white space where data density is needed. Use strict borders and subtle shading.
Ensure the highlighted delayed deliveries table visually stands out (using the specified delayed row_bg color) and has an immediate action ('Abrir Chamado').
Include 'lucide-react' icons where appropriate to enhance quick scanability.
Implement the CSV import feature taking note of the Portuguese standard formatting (';' delimited, DD/MM/YY date formats).
Ensure all key elements have 'data-testid' attributes for robust testing.
